residuals.observation: Natural green/ochre leaf color, cream modeled roots and realistic volumetric watercolor dominate; the assigned plum/lavender fine pen contour expression is weaker than intended.
Footer uses serif throughout, rather than compatible sans supporting the serif body; its optical size is modest at usage720.
Dappled cast-leaf shadows form a more literal watercolor scene than the restrained ground wash described.

located_observations.location: Left central stem and bottom cutaway
located_observations.observation: Petioles join the upright clump; the root crown continues from the stems into a tapering branching root system exposed through the pot front.
Wrist, palm, thumb and bent fingers are visibly connected; thumb rests on the rim/soil edge while other fingers curve behind the pot.

Eyebrow precedes a dominant single-line title; English companion and subtitle lead into a four-line paragraph. The paragraph end is immediately above the larger date/hour/place group, with access/care and invitation/URL following the same start.
The left canopy/pot and broad right title remain recognizable; the small practical copy is text density rather than fully readable at this thumbnail scale.

Korean syllable counters and component proportions remain distinct. Word gaps are visible, body leading stable, no image texture crosses text. Date/hour dashes read as long midline bars; raster shape does not authenticate a Unicode code point.

located_observations.location: Leaf edges, thumb contour and root branches
located_observations.observation: Fine watercolor edges and local painted highlights are coherent, with no detached hand or broken central root crown visible.

copy.observation: All twelve entries are read once; body has four soft lines and middle-dot optical gaps are retained in raw read.

style.observation: Substantial contemporary botanical cutaway and contrast-stroke title/regular serif body are observed. Dominant green and modeled watercolor diverge from the assigned plum/lavender pen-contour wash; footer sans is not achieved.

substantive_visual.observation: A large connected living plant, exposed roots and human tending contact contribute the care concept; this is not tiny ornament or a text-only result.

excluded_template.observation: Canopy, cutaway and hand form the whole left image structure and balance the broad title/text rhythm, rather than a passive headline/date field with subordinate decoration.

hangul.observation: Mature distinct syllable anatomy, visible counters and meaningful word spaces in all groups; modest regular body/footer optical size at usage720.

information_relationship.observation: One right optical axis links subtitle to full explanation and paragraph ending to practical visit, access/care, invitation and URL.

function_contact.observation: Adult hand touches rim; stems and root crown are continuous in the observational cutaway.

material_edges.observation: Coherent watercolor contour-to-wash surface; fine pen contour identity remains underdeveloped.

ratio.observation: Actual native dimensions recorded without resizing; one-edge half-pixel rounding permitted.
